description: Single composite image (no panel letters) titled "Pass 5" in black at the top, showing two rhomboidal, plate-like contour maps rendered in a blue→green→yellow→orange→red colour map with no numeric colourbar, no axis values and no scale bar printed anywhere. The left rhomboid is dominated by blue and green tones with irregular dark-blue patches in its lower half and only a small lighter core, i.e. a low, diffusely distributed field. The right rhomboid shows a strong concentric gradient: a large central red maximum ringed in turn by orange, yellow, green, cyan and finally blue at the plate corners, i.e. a single, sharply localised peak in the middle of the plate. A red/green/blue coordinate triad labelled X, Y and Z sits at the lower right. The pair therefore contrasts a low diffuse field with a highly localised central maximum, apparently on two different sections/views of the same work-piece in the 5-pass multiaxial-forging condition. Because the colour scale carries no numbers, no field magnitude can be read from the image; the figure supports only a qualitative statement of field/strain heterogeneity after Pass 5.

subfigures.description: Rhomboidal contour map on a blue→green colour map; predominantly blue with dark-blue patches in the lower half and a small lighter (green) core; no red/orange region present, so the field stays low and diffuse across the plate.

Rhomboidal contour map with a large central red maximum surrounded by concentric orange, yellow, green and cyan bands fading to blue at the corners, indicating a strongly localised central peak; no numeric colourbar or axis values are given.

observations.observation: The figure is titled "Pass 5", so it corresponds to the 5-pass multiaxial-forging condition.
The image consists of two rhomboidal (diamond/parallelogram-shaped) contour maps placed side by side; no panel letters (a)/(b) are printed.
The colour map runs from dark blue through green, yellow and orange to red, but no numeric colourbar or legend with values is shown, so the mapped quantity and its magnitude are not readable.
The right rhomboid contains a large central red core ringed by orange, yellow, green and cyan bands, indicating a single strongly localised maximum in the plate centre.
The left rhomboid contains no red or orange region; it is dominated by blue and green with dark-blue patches in its lower half, indicating a lower, more diffuse field than the right panel.
A red/green/blue coordinate triad labelled X, Y and Z is drawn at the lower right of the figure.
Neither map carries axis labels, coordinate ticks or a scale bar, so the physical size of the plates cannot be determined from the image.
